note: The fb_groups folding is consistent in the snapshot and its selftest, but the worker edit also drops an unrelated bot-board entry and folds Facebook-group tags with a case-sensitive test that does not match camp-data's.

points.what: This campaign-only change also deletes the "recall-explain.yml" entry from the bot-board names (BN). If that workflow still runs, the /live bots board will list it under "אחר" with its raw name instead of "הסברי הריקולים" in the data group.
points.fix: Restore "recall-explain.yml":["הסברי הריקולים","נתונים"] in BN, unless the workflow was really removed.

dropped.what: The worker's fam() matches /^fbg_[a-z]{1,20}$/ against the raw topic, so it is case-sensitive. camp-data.mjs's family() lowercases first, and its selftest expects FBG_AA to fold. A mixed-case group tag would be folded into fb_groups in the snapshot but shown as its own row on /live, so the two disagree.
dropped.fix: Lowercase the topic before testing it in fam() (or add the i flag), matching family() in camp-data.mjs.
dropped.why: a line the change did not touch
